Board Charter:
Provides guidance to the Board in the
discharge of its fiduciary duties concerning:
• Board and Governance structure;
• Powers, Role, Responsibilities and
Practices of the Board;
• Code of Conduct and Ethics;
• Conflict of Interest and Board
Independence;
• Board processes; and
• Board evaluation and effectiveness.
The Companies’ Board Charters have been
published on the Group’s website.
During the year, the Board Charters were
enhanced to cover in further detail matters
relating to induction and the Board Work
Plan, among other enhancements the
governance auditor recommended. The
revised Charters were approved by the
respective Boards.
Board Remuneration, Attraction and Reten:
A set of guidelines and criteria for the Board’s
compensation, attraction and retention of Directors
through:
• a transparent, fair and reasonable remuneration
process;
• a framework that encourages long-term financial
soundness and prudent risk management;
• a good and strong reputation that attracts and
retains high quality Directors;
• opportunities for Directors to advance their skills
hence enabling their long term retention;
• a review of Directors’ Remuneration so as to
provide market competitive compensation; and
• Disclosure via a Directors’ Remuneration Report.
The Director’s remuneration policy and report, including
details of their compensation, appears on page 88 to 92
of this Report.
